flutter_secure_storage_windows: The Windows side of flutter_secure_storage, vendored in mobile/packages (DPAPI in Dart, without the C++ plugin that needs ATL): a federated implementation for windows only
immuch_desktop_video: The fork's decoder probe for Immuch360 Desktop (Direct3D 11 decoder profiles through dart:ffi), in mobile/packages; its plugin platform is windows only, imported under mobile/lib/desktop only
media_kit: Video through libmpv for Immuch360 Desktop: a copy in mobile/packages (pure Dart, no plugin platforms, its web asset removed so that no build bundles it), imported under mobile/lib/desktop only
media_kit_libs_windows_video: The libmpv and ANGLE libraries of media_kit for Windows, a copy in mobile/packages whose plugin platform is windows only
media_kit_video: The video texture plugin of media_kit, a copy in mobile/packages whose plugin platforms are linux, macos and windows only; imported under mobile/lib/desktop only
safe_local_storage: Brought by media_kit; pure Dart, no plugin platforms, imported by media_kit only
screen_retriever: Brought by window_manager; plugin platforms linux, macos and windows only
screen_retriever_linux: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; linux only
screen_retriever_macos: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; macos only
screen_retriever_platform_interface: The Dart interface of screen_retriever, imported by it only
screen_retriever_windows: Brought by window_manager through screen_retriever; windows only
synchronized: Brought by media_kit and media_kit_video; pure Dart, no plugin platforms
uri_parser: Brought by media_kit; pure Dart, no plugin platforms, imported by media_kit only
window_manager: The window of Immuch360 Desktop; plugin platforms linux, macos and windows only, imported under mobile/lib/desktop only
